description: Sylvan Tactics as installed for captured policy 4 (4.1): the roster that policy-3 and policy-4 captures keep after policy 5 replaced the installed one.

skill.name: Sylvan Tactics
skill.description: Friendly creatures gain Initiative and passive benefits from patient, coordinated tactics.

perks.name: Hunting Pack
perks.description: Friendly Rampart creatures deal +15% damage to enemy stacks that have not yet acted this round.

effect.description: Friendly Rampart creatures deal +15% damage to enemy stacks that have not yet acted this round.

perks.details: Completing an action or Defending counts as acting. Waiting alone does not. The bonus applies to melee and ranged attacks and to retaliations without granting another action.

perks.name: Fleetfoot
perks.description: Friendly creatures gain +1 Speed during their first activation of combat.

effect.description: Friendly creatures gain +1 Speed during their first activation of combat.

perks.details: Only the first creature activation receives this Speed bonus. Waiting, Defending and subsequent activations do not renew it.

perks.name: Patient Hunter
perks.description: The first attack after Waiting deals +15% damage.

effect.description: The first attack after Waiting deals +15% damage.

perks.details: Waiting prepares one attack bonus, consumed by the first qualifying attack. It grants no extra attack or activation.

perks.name: Dappled Cover
perks.description: A creature that voluntarily moves at least 3 hexes during its activation takes 20% less ranged attack damage until its next activation.

effect.description: A creature that voluntarily moves at least 3 hexes during its activation takes 20% less ranged attack damage until its next activation.

perks.details: All movement the creature is ordered to make during one activation counts. Teleports and forced movement do not. It does not reduce melee attacks or spell damage.

perks.name: Evergreen Blessings
perks.description: Your beneficial temporary hero spells last two additional combat rounds on friendly Rampart creatures.

effect.description: Your beneficial temporary hero spells last two additional combat rounds on friendly Rampart creatures.

perks.details: Only beneficial hero spell effects with a temporary combat-round duration qualify. Instantaneous, permanent and other duration types are unchanged.

perks.name: Quick Redeployment
perks.description: After a creature retaliates, it gains +2 Initiative until its next activation.

effect.description: After a creature retaliates, it gains +2 Initiative until its next activation.

perks.details: Repeated retaliations refresh the bonus without stacking it. Pre-emptive blows, Counterfire and Overwatch shots do not count as retaliations.

perks.name: Disruptive Strike
perks.description: Melee hits reduce the target’s Initiative by 15% until its next activation.

effect.description: Melee hits reduce the target’s Initiative by 15% until its next activation.

perks.details: Damaging direct melee attacks and retaliations qualify. Repeated hits refresh the effect without stacking; it ends at the target’s next activation.

perks.name: Kindred Flame
perks.description: Breath attacks by your Green and Gold Dragons do not damage friendly creatures.

effect.description: Breath attacks by your Green and Gold Dragons do not damage friendly creatures.

perks.details: The attack keeps its normal breath geometry and damage against enemies; it creates neither extra targets nor additional attacks.

perks.name: Ancient Accord
perks.description: Your beneficial hero spells bypass the native spell-level immunity of friendly Rampart creatures.

effect.description: Your beneficial hero spells bypass the native spell-level immunity of friendly Rampart creatures.

perks.details: Bypasses only the creature’s intrinsic spell-level immunity for your beneficial hero spells. Artifact immunities, blanket immunities and protection against hostile spells remain unchanged.
